title: Declare execution_kind on every acceptance, separate from harness/category

facts.note: REQUIRED (jointly with operation): the changed artifact is an acceptance definition authored by the planner.
REQUIRED (jointly with file_kind): any acceptance being authored or edited. Activation does not depend on whether execution_kind is already present or correct.
ALTERNATIVE trigger at task level: a planner task that produces or revises acceptances activates the rule even before a file diff exists.

values: new acceptance added (with or without execution_kind)
existing acceptance edited while lacking execution_kind
facts.note: ALTERNATIVE refinements (any one suffices, none is a prerequisite): needs a diff/schema observer reading the acceptance's execution_kind and harness/category fields. Used to target the check, not to gate activation.

values: execution_kind inconsistent with what the acceptance touches (live infra vs hermetic)
hermetic_integration acceptance uses fakes without a declared fidelity contract
facts.note: OPTIONAL diagnostic trigger, NOT a prerequisite: such a finding re-fires the rule on an otherwise untouched acceptance; deciding whether verification touches live HTTP/DB/auth/deployment needs judgment of the acceptance text.

fires: Planner authors a new acceptance, whether or not it already declares a correct execution_kind.
Planner edits an existing acceptance that lacks an execution_kind.
Planner (re)selects harness code/type or category on an acceptance.
An acceptance verifies against a live deployment, database, auth provider or HTTP endpoint and must be classified.
An acceptance uses recorded LLM responses or cassettes instead of live infrastructure and must be classified.
A review finding reports an acceptance whose execution_kind is missing or inconsistent with what it touches.
doesNotFire: Editing plan or wagon prose that does not create or change an acceptance.
Code changes by a coder that do not touch acceptance definitions.

given: You author or edit an acceptance, selecting harness code/type and category as usual.
when: You classify the runtime environment it runs against.
then: Add execution_kind as a separate axis: hermetic_integration (real subject, boundary shape and integration sequence, no live external infrastructure) or live_smoke (verified against real live HTTP, DB, auth or deployment).
prefer: Select harness/category exactly as before, then add execution_kind.
hermetic_integration when the real integration runs without live infrastructure.
live_smoke when confidence comes from live infrastructure; SMOKE stays the live-infrastructure tier.
avoid: Encoding runtime environment in harness codes/types or category, or changing those enums.
Marking hermetic_integration an acceptance that calls live infrastructure.
Fakes (cassettes, recorded LLM responses) in hermetic_integration without a declared fidelity contract.
Treating hermetic_integration as a substitute for SMOKE's live confidence.
why: Live vs hermetic is a different question from harness or category; a separate axis keeps those enums stable while making live-infrastructure dependence explicit.
evidence: Every new or edited acceptance carries an execution_kind with value hermetic_integration or live_smoke.
harness_codes/harness_types/category values are drawn from the unchanged enums.
Acceptances marked hermetic_integration reference no live external infrastructure; any fakes they use have a declared fidelity contract.
Acceptances marked live_smoke verify against real live HTTP, DB, auth or deployment.
verifier_detail: execution_kind is an enum with exactly two values: hermetic_integration, live_smoke.
execution_kind is orthogonal to harness_codes, harness_types and category; those enums are unchanged and must not be validated against execution_kind.

hermetic_integration: real subject, real boundary shape, real integration sequence, NO live external infrastructure; fakes (cassettes, recorded LLM responses) permitted only with a declared fidelity contract (detailed in planner.acceptance.hermetic-fake-contract).
live_smoke: verification against real live infrastructure (HTTP, DB, auth, deployment); SMOKE remains the live-infrastructure confidence tier.
Term definition: execution_kind = the runtime-environment classifier for an acceptance.
